extraction_host_requirement.detail: The frozen extraction path consumes the model-facing CHW float32 tensor. Person A has already materialized those exact payloads with hashes, so the extraction host needs Person A's payloads rather than re-running preprocessing on the canonical PNGs. The canonical PNGs remain the upstream pixel authority and are listed so the host can re-derive if an owner requires it.

steps: 1. an owner assigns <APPROVED_DESTINATION_URI> and records it in docs/status/person_a_phase9_clean_run_v0_1/external_artifact_index.json
2. python scripts/build_person_a_66_cell_preprocessed_media_v0_2.py verify  # re-derive and re-verify all 2468 model-facing payloads before upload
3. upload every payload under the external payload root to <APPROVED_DESTINATION_URI>/person-a-66-cell-preprocessed-frames-v0-2/frames/<trajectory_id>/<model_frame_idx>.f32le
4. recompute SHA-256 for every uploaded object and require an exact match against the manifest payload_sha256 values
5. materialize on aws_sagemaker_linux_gpu and re-verify every digest and byte size before Step 6.1
